title: Roman curse tablets
creator: Roman Baths, Bath & North East Somerset Council
provenance: Official Roman Baths collection page describing the approximately 130 inscribed lead or pewter tablets, their second-to-late-fourth-century dating, and deposition in the Sacred Spring.
notes: The source describes them as personal/private prayers and notes that many concern perceived injustice; LEGEND does not reduce all tablets to one motive.
